annotations.title: Speech to text from an audio URL

description: Speech to text from an audio URL — Transcribe a public audio file (mp3, wav, m4a, ogg, webm, flac up to 1.5 MB, about 90 seconds of mp3) with Whisper large-v3-turbo: full text, detected language, duration and timestamped segments. Optional language= hint. Price: $0.01 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: ai_transcribe
